defaultPrompt: Use CMO.so Website (WordPress) to build and look after a WordPress site on the Maggie Core theme through CMO.so alone: add, design, change or remove pages and sections, fix SEO, change the menu, header, footer and brand.

Use CMO.so Website (WordPress) to keep a site's own look — brand colours, fonts, header, footer, patterns, small CSS — in a child theme of Maggie Core, so the parent theme can update safely and the site's design lives in files, not only in the database.
